blocks.html: Five percent, but not less than one, of each type of gaming table provided shall be accessible and provided with a front approach. Five percent of gaming machines provided shall be accessible and provided with a front approach. Accessible gaming machines shall be distributed throughout the different types of gaming machines provided.
